title: Twelve years with Earl Foster, including Thibodaux college inn
summary: Harris has played with Foster for about twelve years, mostly within fifty miles, including four years in Thibodaux.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Uh from Kid René you say you went with Papa Celestan and then after Papa Celestan you played with Earl Foster. Earl Foster. And you've been with him all these years?
All these years. How many years? Yeah. It's about 12 years now.
And you played just in the city though? You don't go out of the town?
No. Well we goes out in suburb towns you know about 40-50 miles. Uh huh. Just short term. We stayed four years out in Thibodeau at the college inn.
Oh yes. Earl Foster was telling us that.
Yeah. Four years out in Thibodeau at the college inn. Yeah. We always say we leave when the sugarcane coming up. Yeah. And when we coming back you're cutting it down when leaves coming up. Yeah.
Y'all stayed a long time in the job over here too?
Oh yeah at the plantation. We stayed over there a good while too.
Did you live in those towns then when you go there or you go back and forth?

Yeah. We always leave, get off the job, come home, go back, come home. Well you see Earl had those big trucks he had to be running every day. That's before he got hurt you know. Yeah. He had to go on them trucks every day.
He come back and work all done.
